## What he does

- Technical SEO: crawlability, indexation, site architecture, Core Web Vitals,
  structured data, internal linking, implemented directly in the codebase.
- Programmatic SEO: template and data driven pages built to scale into thousands
  of URLs without becoming thin content.
- AEO / GEO: structuring content and entities so answer engines and AI search
  surfaces cite the source.
- AI automation: AI content production agents and AI email outreach agents for
  link building.
- Content strategy: keyword research, search intent mapping, content gap
  analysis, topical clusters.
- SEO engineering: Next.js and React builds that are search-ready on day one.
